titleEn: TurtleTree, Novonesis strike partnership to scale up precision-fermented lactoferrin
titleZh: TurtleTree与Novonesis合作扩大精准发酵乳铁蛋白生产
summaryZh: 生物科技初创公司TurtleTree与生物解决方案巨头Novonesis达成合作，以扩大其精准发酵平台，首先聚焦乳铁蛋白产品。Novonesis对TurtleTree进行了少数股权投资，三井化学的风险投资部门也参与其中。TurtleTree已从细胞培养奶转向精准发酵平台，生产难以用动物方法规模化生产的乳蛋白。其乳铁蛋白产品已获FDA批准，计划拓展早期营养、补充剂和女性健康市场。
featuredReason: 虽然乳铁蛋白精准发酵技术本身不直接涉及智慧畜牧的IoT/AI/自动化，但其对奶牛养殖业中乳蛋白替代生产的影响值得关注，尤其是对乳品供应链和功能性配料领域。
contentFull:
Biotech startup TurtleTree and biosolutions giant Novonesis have struck an agreement to scale the former’s precision fermentation platform, starting with its lactoferrin product.

The partnership includes a minority investment into TurtleTree on the part of Novonesis. Financial terms of the deal, which also included participation from 321Catalyst Ventures, the corporate venture capital arm of Mitsui Chemicals, are undisclosed at this time.

US- and Singapore-based TurtleTree has in the last few years shifted its business from developing cell-cultured milk in bioreactors to becoming a precision fermentation platform making dairy proteins that are difficult to produce at scale using animal-based methods.

The first of these proteins is lactoferrin, found naturally in milk. Sometimes nicknamed “pink gold,” it’s a multifunctional protein known to have benefits across iron regulation, gut health and immunity, says TurtleTree founder and CEO Fengru Lin.

Currently, the extraction costs of lactoferrin are too high to use the protein at any kind of meaningful scale in supplements and ingredients, hence the rise in companies attempting to produce it via precision fermentation.

Last year, TurtleTree received a No Questions letter from the US Food and Drug Administration for its lactoferrin LF+ product, marking the first time a regulatory body worldwide approved lactoferrin produced via precision fermentation.

While the company primarily focuses on formulations for B2B customers, it has also launched a small B2C brand called Intentional, where consumers can access TurtleTree’s product in capsule form. 

Towards commercialization

Lin says the new partnership and investment will help TurtleTree move to its next stage on the road to manufacturing lactoferrin at food scale.

“With every startup, the biggest challenge is getting to unit economics that makes sense for the food industry, especially when we’re using techniques that are a lot of times brought over by the therapeutics or the pharma industry,” she adds.

TurtleTree is focused in particular on early-life nutrition, a category Lin says sits somewhere between food and pharma.

“You need to be producing at a much higher quality than just regular food for early-life nutrition, so to be able to bridge that gap,” she explains, adding that a company like Novonesis “is well established to achieve that with the current capabilities around human milk oligosaccharides, around other bioactives that are already in infant nutrition.”

Novonesis will help TurtleTree drive costs down, while Mitsui Chemicals is strong in Japan, one of the world’s largest producers of lactoferrin, according to Lin.

In parallel, TurtleTree is currently focused on expanding into the supplements and women’s health market, as lactoferrin’s iron-binding and immunity-boosting benefits are especially beneficial for women.

Ultimately, she adds, it’s about pairing TurtleTree’s precision fermentation capabilities with manufacturing and commercialization capabilities to provide a more consistent product, cost structure, and supply chain for health and wellness brands.

“This enables our customers to formulate with confidence and deliver meaningful benefits to the people who rely on these products every day.”

translationZh:
生物科技初创公司TurtleTree与生物解决方案巨头Novonesis达成协议，以扩大前者的精准发酵平台，首先从其乳铁蛋白产品开始。

该合作包括Novonesis对TurtleTree的少数股权投资。该交易的财务条款目前未披露，三井化学的企业风险投资部门321Catalyst Ventures也参与了投资。

总部位于美国和新加坡的TurtleTree在过去几年中已将其业务从在生物反应器中开发细胞培养奶转变为成为精准发酵平台，生产使用动物方法难以规模化生产的乳蛋白。

这些蛋白质中的第一种是乳铁蛋白，天然存在于牛奶中。TurtleTree创始人兼首席执行官Fengru Lin表示，乳铁蛋白有时被称为“粉金”，是一种多功能蛋白质，已知在铁调节、肠道健康和免疫方面具有益处。

目前，乳铁蛋白的提取成本过高，无法在补充剂和配料中以任何有意义的规模使用，因此越来越多的公司尝试通过精准发酵生产它。

去年，TurtleTree收到了美国食品药品监督管理局对其乳铁蛋白LF+产品的“无问题”信函，这标志着全球监管机构首次批准通过精准发酵生产的乳铁蛋白。

虽然该公司主要专注于面向B2B客户的配方，但它也推出了一个名为Intentional的小型B2C品牌，消费者可以通过胶囊形式获得TurtleTree的产品。

**迈向商业化**

Lin表示，新的合作和投资将帮助TurtleTree进入以食品规模生产乳铁蛋白的下一阶段。

“对于每家初创公司来说，最大的挑战是实现对食品行业有意义的单位经济性，尤其是当我们使用通常来自治疗或制药行业的技术时，”她补充道。

TurtleTree特别关注早期营养，Lin称这一类别介于食品和药品之间。

“你需要以比普通食品高得多的质量生产早期营养产品，以弥合这一差距，”她解释道，并补充说像Novonesis这样的公司“在围绕人乳低聚糖和婴儿营养中已有的其他生物活性物质方面拥有当前能力，能够很好地实现这一目标。”

据Lin称，Novonesis将帮助TurtleTree降低成本，而三井化学在日本实力雄厚，日本是全球最大的乳铁蛋白生产国之一。

与此同时，TurtleTree目前正专注于扩展到补充剂和女性健康市场，因为乳铁蛋白的铁结合和免疫增强益处对女性尤其有益。

最终，她补充道，关键在于将TurtleTree的精准发酵能力与制造和商业化能力相结合，为健康和保健品牌提供更一致的产品、成本结构和供应链。

“这使我们的客户能够充满信心地进行配方，并为每天依赖这些产品的人们提供有意义的益处。”
author: Jennifer Marston
